documents.content: Ocean acidification happens when seawater absorbs atmospheric carbon dioxide, lowering pH and changing carbonate chemistry.
Coral reefs and shell-forming organisms face risks as ocean acidity changes carbonate availability.
Climate change raises global average temperatures as greenhouse gas concentrations increase.
Mitigation policies reduce carbon dioxide emissions from energy production and transport.
Quantum entanglement links measurement outcomes of distant systems under quantum mechanics.
Phase coherence is an essential property of quantum states used in interference experiments.
Rust ownership and borrowing enforce memory safety without a garbage collector.
Use-after-free bugs happen when a program accesses memory after its lifetime has ended.
Server-side request forgery allows an attacker to make a server request protected internal network resources.
HTML injection and cross-site scripting occur when untrusted input is interpreted as markup or script.
Decentralized search distributes indexing and retrieval among independently operated peers.
A federated index lets users search remote collections while retaining local control over data.
Scientific claims should expose source provenance, uncertainty, methods, replication status and correction history.
Evidence classification distinguishes unverified claims, preliminary tests, replicated findings and established evidence.
Data minimization keeps personal information local and reduces unnecessary collection, retention and sharing.
Consent receipts provide verifiable records of what data a user allowed to be shared and why.
Solar photovoltaic systems convert sunlight into electrical energy using semiconductor cells.
Grid-scale battery storage helps balance variable renewable generation and electricity demand.
BM25 ranks documents using term frequency, document frequency and document length normalization.
Dense vector retrieval uses representation similarity to find semantically related documents.
A web browser engine implements HTML parsing, CSS style calculation, layout, JavaScript and rendering.
Process isolation separates untrusted web content from privileged browser services.
AI systems should provide traceable citations, calibrated uncertainty and remain unable to bypass deterministic authorization.
Replicated state and Byzantine fault tolerance help distributed nodes agree despite some malicious participants.
